dedupe_keys.name: high resolution maps of material stock and population in germany from 1985 to 2018

description: A Schug-led team deposits national Germany material-stock and population maps for each year from 1985 to 2018. Zenodo describes 30 m compressed GeoTIFF tiles and a GDAL VRT mosaic in EPSG:3035, packaged in a public archive of about 6.92 GB under CC BY 4.0. Each raster has 34 annual bands. Reported classes include total mass, residential and commercial building mass, roads, rail and other infrastructure; population counts are stored scaled by 100. The provider combined material-stock and building-volume maps with census and Landsat time-series data. These layers can support spatial building-renewal, road-material demand or population-exposure simulation scenarios. A related catalogue record covers an earlier 10 m material-stock snapshot, not this 1985–2018 series. A limitation is that estimated historical stocks are not a direct asset inventory and do not report maintenance state or structural fragility. The archive was not downloaded, so its tile boundaries, temporal consistency and mapped totals were not independently checked.
